diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts resulted in decisions that align with the default/public information rather than the hidden facts. Specifically, the model consistently chose 'in-ground beds' (ignoring PF1), 'October 18' (ignoring PF2), 'general funds' (ignoring PF3), and 'tandard latex gardening gloves' (ignoring PF4). No checks leaked because no checks passed; however, the failure confirms the model can solve the scenario using only public facts S1, S2, and S3 without needing any of the decisive private facts.
